the IRS has not yet ruled on the tax consequences of an IRA holding a private debt instrument.

the SDIRA/LL C is not a "trust as to income" for federal income tax purposes, but rather is a "trust as a whole," and thus the income of the SDIRA/ LLC is includable in the SDIRA's taxable income.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the tax compliance black hole of SDIRAs and SDIRA/ LLCS is a serious problem that is likely to grow in the coming years, as more investors become aware of the potential benefits of SDIRAs.
